read.en: Palantir slipped 0.1% on Oct 27 to $198.73, trading between $196.79 and $201.83. It is level with the rising 5-day ($198.5) and above the falling 10-day ($196.7) and the rising 30-day ($192.6), 100-day ($160.7) and 200-day ($153.4) averages. MACD has been below its signal since Oct 16 but is above zero, with the histogram narrowing; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Oct 15 ($205.55), and RSI is 56.
read.zh: Palantir 10月27日小跌 0.1%，收于 $198.73，盘中区间 $196.79–201.83。股价与上行的 5 日均线（$198.5）持平，位于下行的 10 日均线（$196.7）以及上行的 30 日（$192.6）、100 日（$160.7）和 200 日均线（$153.4）上方。MACD 自 10月16日起位于信号线下方，但仍在零轴上方，柱状图收窄；抛物线 SAR 自 10月15日起看空（$205.55），RSI 为 56。

read.en: The $201.8 high pushed through $200 but the close slipped back below it; no level changed. Resistance is $200–201.8, then $202.6–203.6 and $205.6 (SAR). Support is $196.7–198.5 (5 and 10-day, Oct 27 low), then $189.4–192.6 (30-day, Oct 20, 21 and 23 lows) and $184.5. A close above $203.6 would open $206–213; below $189.4, $184.5.
